title: Nashville chef's final call to friend raises suspicions about former football scout in her death - CBS News
description: What started out as a special dinner date between Jade Benning, a Nashville chef, and Blaise Taylor, an assistant football scout, at her Nashville apartment ended in her call to a friend — and his call to 911.

title: Heidi Klum Dressed Up as a Severed Human Hand for Her Annual Halloween Party - Variety
description: Heidi Klum took to the red carpet of her annual Halloween fest in her wildest costume yet, dressing as a severed human hand.

title: Inde Navarrette Makes Shane Gillis Quip 'SNL' Opening Monologue - Deadline
description: Following her "scream queen" debut in 'Obsession', Inde Navarrette flexed her comedy muscle with her Saturday Night Live hosting debut.

title: How the Golden State Valkyries won the 2026 WNBA title in just two years - ESPN
description: When Golden State joined the WNBA, the owner said the team would win a title within five years. The Valkyries did it in two.

title: Georgia passed permanent daylight saving time bill. Here’s why clocks still fall back - WSB-TV
description: Georgia passed a bill to make daylight saving time permanent. But it would require congressional approval to take effect. And that hasn’t happened yet.
